files.description: Comprehensive tests for the cluster-based face assignment page (/faces): quick person creation, assigning a single face via the sidebar searchable select, similarity auto-matching to people, similarity clustering, keyboard-shortcut assignment, and the per-cluster pager / skip-cluster navigation. Runs in serial mode because the tests share one server-side pool of unassigned faces.

testContext: The /faces page groups unassigned faces into .suggestion-group clusters rendered server-side, but the .face thumbnails inside are painted CLIENT-SIDE into the active group's .grid only — one cluster is visible at a time (others have [hidden]); each group's full face list lives in its data-faces JSON attribute (entries: {id, photo_date, similarity}). All faces of the active cluster start SELECTED (selectedIds = whole cluster); deselect via the .group-select-checkbox, then click individual .face[data-face-id] elements. Assigning or skipping advances to the next cluster or reloads for the next batch. Use URL params (/faces?group_by=similarity&threshold=2 or group_by=people) instead of driving the radio+slider UI. Clusters from DBSCAN have >= 3 faces (min_samples=3); people-mode groups are named after the person (.cluster-name) and carry .assign-group-btn[data-person-name] buttons; unmatched faces land in an 'Unknown' group with null similarity. The sidebar person select (#sidebar-person-select) is a hidden searchable-select — click `#sidebar-person-select + .searchable-select-wrapper .searchable-select-display` then a .searchable-select-option. Keyboard shortcuts (number keys) are rebuilt per cluster into #sidebar-shortcut-people .shortcut-item elements. CRITICAL: POST /api/faces/assign only marks faces PROCESSING and enqueues a background task on the yaffo taskq — the isolated sandbox must run `python -m yaffo.taskq.host` (isolated_runner.ts spawns it since 2026-07-01) and tests must poll the person's /people/{id}/faces page ([data-face-id]) for completion instead of expecting immediate assignment. Person deletion goes through the global confirm dialog (#confirm-dialog-confirm) and returns the person's faces to the unassigned pool, which is how afterEach restores state. People list rows link via a.person-name.row-link to /people/{id}/faces; delete links are a.action-link.delete. Creating a person via the quick action reloads the page ~1.5s after the 201 response, so assert on the repopulated #sidebar-person-select options rather than the transient toast. Playwright's global 5s timeout is too tight for these flows; the describe block overrides it (30s) and uses serial mode.
explanation: 2026-07-01: Rewritten for the redesigned cluster-based faces page and the async taskq pipeline. The old page's flat face grid, #deselect-all button, page-size pagination and #deleteModal are gone; hardcoded OBAMA_FACE_IDS from the dlib era were dropped (InsightFace reseed changed face ids) in favor of asserting positive similarity scores in the matched group's data-faces payload. Assignment verification now polls /people/{id}/faces because /api/faces/assign completes in a background worker. All 6 tests pass against the isolated sandbox (twice in a row, confirming cleanup restores the shared face pool).
